tasks.short: Interview applicants and decide whom to hire.

steps.what: Read applicants papers before the interview.
Decide which applicants to hire after the interview.
File the hiring decision for these applicants.

tasks.design: The lodging manager reads the application, interviews the applicant and decides. {ATS} files only the decision the manager made after the interview. No model ranks applicants or drafts a score.
tasks.previous_blocker: The decision was written beside the application and typed into the hiring record later.
tasks.enabler_now: The hiring record can store a decision that already exists. It cannot make one.
tasks.still_hard: The interview and the hiring decision stay with the manager. EU rules do not allow that decision to rest on automation alone.
tasks.human_edge: The manager interviews and decides. The file is a record of that decision, not a ranking.
tasks.altitude: Interviews and hiring decisions stay. The decision is filed without a second typing. No applicant is scored.

reach.task: Sit in on a desk-clerk interview
reach.learn: Record the decision the hiring manager made, and do not add a score

evidence.claim: A hiring record can store a decision a person made after an interview.
Hiring is a staff decision. Under EU rules it must not rest on automation alone, and a ranking of applicants is not used here.

assumptions: The filed decision stores the applicant id, the role and the decision the manager made after the interview. It does not store a score, a ranking or a model note.
The approval is the decision after the interview. The file step writes that version and no other.
The prior classes this as human. The steps agree. The interview is most of the time.
Whether this employer's hiring tools are high-risk is unknown and is not assumed away. Consent days cover a works-council check before the hiring record is connected.
Upkeep is the role list on the hiring record.
unknowns: Whether a works council must consent before hiring notes are stored in a shared record.
Whether someone other than the lodging manager is the legal hiring decision-maker.
research_questions: Who signs the hiring decision today?

already_counted.description: Reading applications before the interview is already in that step

incremental.description: Keep the role list on the hiring record

approvals.approved_version: hiring decision the lodging manager made after interviewing the applicant

time_saved_range_pct.basis: The interview and the decision remain. Only filing that decision is shorter. The range sits under the central net and is not a measured result.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Purchase supplies and arrange outside services.

steps.what: Choose the supplier for laundry maintenance or trash collection.
Arrange outside services such as deliveries and repair.
Review the purchase order for supplies.
Send the approved purchase order for supplies.

tasks.design: The lodging manager chooses the supplier and arranges laundry, maintenance, repair, deliveries and trash collection. {PROCUREMENT} fills a purchase order from that choice and the short list. The manager checks it, and only that version is sent. No agent places an order.
tasks.previous_blocker: Orders were written in mail after a phone call, then retyped for the supplier.
tasks.enabler_now: An order form can be filled from a supplier and a quantity the manager already chose.
tasks.still_hard: Choosing the supplier and agreeing the service still take a conversation. Prices and quality are not a fixed table.
tasks.human_edge: The manager chooses who supplies the hotel and on what terms. The order only repeats that choice.
tasks.altitude: Calls to suppliers stay. The order is no longer retyped, and it cannot go out before the manager checks the version.

reach.task: Match a supplier invoice to an order
reach.learn: Match against the order the lodging manager sent, not against a suggested supplier

evidence.claim: A purchase order can be filled from a supplier and quantities a person has already chosen, then sent after that person checks it.

assumptions: The order stores the supplier the manager chose, the items, the quantities and the terms the manager arranged. The manager produces the choice. No agent selects a supplier.
The send references the order version the manager reviewed. A later price change needs a new review.
The prior classes this as human. The steps agree on the choice and the arrangement, and only the order form is filled.
Upkeep is the supplier and item identifiers.
unknowns: Whether laundry, trash and repairs are already on annual contracts, so the order is a call-off rather than a new choice.
What the manager may spend without a second signature.
research_questions: Which outside services are contracted, and which are ordered one at a time?

already_counted.description: Reviewing the purchase order is already in that step

incremental.description: Keep supplier and item identifiers current

approvals.approved_version: purchase order the lodging manager signed for the supplier they chose

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Choosing the supplier and arranging the service remain. Sending the checked order is the saving. The range sits under the central net and is not a measured result.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Collect payments and record funds and expenditures.

steps.what: Post a record after you collect payments.
Check the record of funds against cash counted.
Record the expenditures the manager checked.

tasks.design: The lodging manager collects the payment. The till post that already runs is left as system time and is not a saving. The manager checks counted cash against that post. {ERP} records expenditure figures only after that check.
tasks.previous_blocker: Cash and expenditure slips were copied into a sheet after the till had already moved.
tasks.enabler_now: The till already posts. Expenditure lines can be written once the manager has checked the figures.
tasks.still_hard: Collecting money, and explaining a difference, stay at the desk.
tasks.human_edge: The manager collects the money and checks the difference. The record does not invent a figure.
tasks.altitude: Collecting payments stays. The existing till post is not treated as saved time. Expenditure lines the manager has checked are not typed twice.

reach.task: Post the day's takings into the ledger
reach.learn: Use the checked funds figure, and do not treat the till post as a new human task

evidence.claim: A till that already posts takings is existing system work. Recording an expenditure the person has checked is a separate, smaller write.

assumptions: The existing till post is system time and is excluded. It is not saved human labour.

The expenditure record stores the amount, the category and the slip reference the manager checked. The manager produces the check. The machine does not decide the category when the slip is unclear; those stay in the review.
The task is labelled human. The steps agree that collecting and checking stay human.
unknowns: Whether the till post already includes the expenditure lines, or only the takings.
Who may sign a cash difference.
research_questions: Does the till already post takings without a second entry?

already_counted.description: Checking funds against the till is already in the review step

approvals.approved_version: expenditures the lodging manager checked against the counted funds

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Collecting and checking remain. The existing till post is not saved human labour. 24 percent is work the system already does and is not saved human labour. The range sits under the central net and is not a measured result.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Develop and implement department policies and procedures.

steps.what: Review current procedures for the department.
Develop policies for the department operation.
Draft procedures the manager chose to implement.

loop.input: The manager's policy decision and the current signed procedure
loop.output: A revised procedure that changes only the headings the manager named
loop.check: The lodging manager edits or keeps each heading, and rejects any rule that was not in the decision
loop.stop: One pass. Headings the manager did not name stay as they are. No citations are added. No second pass.
loop.why_not_simpler: Procedure text is prose, so a blank form cannot write the change the manager decided

steps.what: Sign the policies you will implement.
Publish the signed procedures for the department.

tasks.design: The lodging manager decides the policy and signs the procedure. A draft may revise only the headings the manager named, from the current signed text, and the manager signs that version. {WORKFLOW} publishes the signed procedure. It invents no rule and no legal citation.
tasks.previous_blocker: Procedures lived in files and were mailed out as attachments with no version.
tasks.enabler_now: A records register can publish a version the manager has signed, and can record who must read it.
tasks.still_hard: Deciding the rule, and signing it, stay with the manager. The draft must not add sources.
tasks.human_edge: The manager writes the rule. The register only publishes the version they signed.
tasks.altitude: Writing and signing procedures stay. Publishing the signed version, and knowing who has read it, replaces the mail-out.

reach.learn: Follow the signed version, and do not treat a draft as the rule

evidence.claim: A procedure register can publish a version a named person has signed, and can record read receipts.
A draft must not add citations. Invented sources are a known failure mode of generated procedure text.

assumptions: The draft uses only the current signed procedure and the headings the manager decided to change. It adds no legal citation and no outside source.
The publish step references the version the manager signed. A later edit is a new version and needs a new signature.
The prior classes this as amplify. The steps keep the decision and the signature human.
Upkeep is the review dates on the published procedures.
unknowns: Which procedures are already in a register with versions, and which are still files in a mailbox.
Who besides the lodging manager must sign before a procedure is the rule.
research_questions: Is there already a signed-procedure register, or only files?

already_counted.description: Reviewing the current text and the draft is already in those steps

incremental.description: Keep review dates on published procedures

approvals.approved_version: department procedure the lodging manager signed before publication

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Deciding and signing the procedure remain. Publishing that signed version is the saving. The range sits under the central net and is not a measured result.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

role.altitude: Interviews, supplier choices and collecting payments stay. Filing a hiring decision, sending a checked order and publishing a signed procedure take less retyping.
reach: A finance colleague matches invoices to the order the manager sent
Department heads follow the procedure version the manager signed
skills_to_grow: Recording a hiring decision without a score
Sending a purchase order only after checking the supplier they chose
Signing a procedure before it is published
role.ambitious_version: Each hire, each order and each procedure that leaves the office is the version the lodging manager signed.
